bio.text: Ron Stephens, a Republican from Savannah, represents the 164th District in the Georgia House of Representatives.
According to his legislative biography, Stephens has been a pharmacist for more than 46 years and holds a degree in pharmacy from Armstrong State and Mercer University.
The biography says he served as a city councilman in Garden City before his election to the House.
